            if (right > 0 and left < 0) or (right < 0 and left > 0) then
              res := 0
            elseif  Abs(right) <= Abs(left) then
              res := left
            elseif Abs(right) > Abs(left) then
              res := MaxOfAbs(right * e Max_differential  / 100, left)
            endif
            
            
            Result := res
          END 128074
        END 128070

          Name=Default function
          Description=
          Qcode expression:
            right := DMAC_EV_1_Right
            left := DMAC_EV_2_Left
            
            if (right > 0 and left < 0) or (right < 0 and left > 0) then
              res := 0
            elseif  Abs(right) <= Abs(left) then
              res := left

              res := MaxOfAbs(right * T Max_diffrential  / 100, left)
            endif
            
            
            Result := res
          END 205918

      BEGIN 232171
      Math channel (MAC)
      Name=create new state tyva elec
      Description=
      Unit=Not used
      Function selector=Not used
      X=1350
      Y=290
        
        BEGIN 232172
        Function
        Name=Default function
        Description=
        Qcode expression:
          static outputValue:= 0
          
          if Drive Type mc=0 and Is_Tyva=0 then//0 mean elec
            outputValue := 0  //0 mean elec no tyva
          elseif Drive Type mc=0 and Is_Tyva=1 then //0 mean elec
            outputValue := 2 //2 mean elec no tyva
          elseif Drive Type mc=1 then //1 mean fossil
            outputValue := 1 //1 mean fossil
          endif
          
          Result := outputValue
        END 232172
      END 232171
